# asc_vm_group (Data Source)

Reads a virtual machine group by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "asc_vm_group" "example" {
  name = "example-group"
}

output "example_group_replicas" {
  value = data.asc_vm_group.example.autoscaling.max_replicas
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the virtual machine group.

### Read-Only

- `attached_volumes` (List of String) Names of the volumes attached to the group, sorted; the gateway does not report them in a stable order.
- `autoscaling` (Attributes) Scaling bounds of the group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--autoscaling))
- `last_error` (String) Last error reported for the group, empty when there is none.
- `sku` (Attributes) SKU backing every member of the group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sku))
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status reported by infra-gateway.
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags on the group.
- `urn` (String) Resource identifier of the group.

<a id="nestedatt--autoscaling"></a>
### Nested Schema for `autoscaling`

Read-Only:

- `cron` (Attributes) Cron window overriding the replica count, null when the group has none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--autoscaling--cron))
- `max_replicas` (Number) Upper replica bound.
- `min_replicas` (Number) Lower replica bound.

<a id="nestedatt--autoscaling--cron"></a>
### Nested Schema for `autoscaling.cron`

Read-Only:

- `desired_replicas` (Number) Replica count held while the window is open.
- `end` (String) Cron expression closing the window.
- `start` (String) Cron expression opening the window.
- `timezone` (String) IANA timezone the window is expressed in.



<a id="nestedatt--sku"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sku`

Read-Only:

- `cores` (Number) Physical cores.
- `family` (String) Instance family of the SKU.
- `gpu_count` (Number) Number of GPUs, 0 when the SKU has none.
- `gpu_type` (String) GPU model, empty when the SKU has none.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the SKU.
- `memory_in_mb` (Number) Memory in MB.
- `name` (String) Name of the SKU.
- `storage_in_gb` (Number) Storage in GB.
- `storage_type` (String) Storage type backing the SKU.
- `threads` (Number) Threads per core.
